answer: Proof-of-stake protocols defend AI agent economies against Sybil attacks by requiring capital commitment to validate network transitions. Like a shifting tide, the distribution of economic weight ensures that creating fraudulent nodes remains computationally impractical. An attacker must hold substantial assets to exert influence, a signal of their commitment to network health. Without this capital, the cost of generating identities becomes as fruitless as building a sand dune against a rising sea of objective truth.
